checks.detail: Four v5.9 references retain frozen formats and no implicit execution.
All ten required contribution families have explicit permissions and host exports.
Manifest normalization retains every bounded, permission-reviewed contribution family.
The certified WASM fixture initializes in two isolated generations without shared state.
Native ABI 1 requires explicit grants and produces an isolated non-implicit launch plan.
Safe official input passes while traversal/executable, archive bomb, unknown permission and native-browser candidates fail closed.
A clean bounded official registry imports entirely offline without fetching content.
Windows clean-machine and Linux matching-host evidence remain pending; Android remains blocked.
Content cache keys are order-independent and delta manifests classify changes deterministically.
Remote delivery is permission-gated and yields a non-executable, no-network plan.
